learning_outcomes.text: Students will be able to solve thermodynamic problems based on logic, not memorization.
Students will be able to find the efficiency of heating and cooling cycles using thermophysical properties.
Students will be able to create P-x, P-y curves for a two-component system.
Students will be able to calculate the heat and work requirements of physical and chemical processes.
Students will be able to solve thermodynamics problems of fluid processes.

syllabus_topics: Systems and Definitions/ Concept of Equilibrium/ Temperature and Reversibility/ First Law of Thermodynamics, Concepts of Work and Heat/ Second Law and Entropy / Carnot cycle / Thermodynamic Properties of Pure Substances and Equations of State / Generalized State Properties / Vapor and combined power cycles, Refrigeration cycles
Introduction to Thermodynamics and Basic Concepts
Energy, Energy Transfer, 1st Law of Thermodynamics
Properties of pure substances, PVT behavior of pure substances
Energy Analysis of Closed Systems: Moving Boundary Work, Energy Balance for Closed Systems
Energy Analysis of Closed Systems: Specific Heat, Internal Energy, Enthalpy for Gases, Liquids and Solids
Second Law of Thermodynamics: Heat Engines, Carnot cycle
Entropy: Principle of Increase of Entropy, Entropy Change of Pure Substances, Isentropic State Changes, Property Diagrams Involving Entropy
Entropy: Entropy Change of Ideal Gases, Reversible Steady Flow Work, Minimization of Compressor Work, Isentropic Efficiencies of Steady Flow Devices, Entropy Balance
Thermodynamic cycles: Gas power cycles, Vapor and combined power cycles
bibliography: J. M. Smith, H. C. Van Ness, M. M. Abbott, Introduction to Chemical Engineering Thermodynamics 7e (The Mcgraw-Hill Chemical Engineering Series).
S. I. Sandler, Chemical, Biochemical and Engineering Thermodynamics, 4th Edition, Wiley, 2006.
Çengel, Yunus A., “Introduction to Thermodynamics and Heat Transfer”, McGraw_Hill, 1997.
R.C. Reid, J.M. Prausnitz and B.E. Poling, Properties of Gases and Liquids, 4th ed., McGraw-Hill, 1987.
